Data Collection

Discussion
Validation of Hypothesis
EMF Predictions: Most artifact EMF readings (1–7 mG) fall within or slightly below predicted ranges (4–8 mG), supporting the non-physical encoding hypothesis. Ghost echoes(4 mG) and poltergeists (8 mG) align with predictions (9.7 mG and 12.15 mG, respectively), accounting for temporal decay and dynamic factors.Temporal Preservation (): Artifacts have higher  (1230–9670) than paranormal phenomena (192–204), reflecting the stability of cosmological/cultural imprints vs. thetransience of emotional imprints ( ).Consciousness-Time Coupling: Refined  , with emotional events (ghost echoes: 1.63 years, poltergeists: 2.04 years) showing larger   than artifacts (0.68–1.36 years), indicating stronger temporal impacts.
Implications for Temporal Math
Emotional Intensity Factor (): Quantifies the faster decay of emotional imprints, enhancing the preservation model.Dynamic Energy Factor (): Models the variability in poltergeist EMF readings, distinguishing active consciousness from static imprints.Harmonic Replay: Explains the persistence of ghost echoes through cyclical patterns, providing a mathematical basis for residual hauntings.Temporal Discontinuities: Emotional events create larger temporal leaps, suggesting consciousness amplifies temporal dynamics.
